the velocity ratio of a foam flowing along parallel channels depends on the foam structure and the width ratio of the two channels.

the structure of the flowing foam is a key factor in determining the flow distribution between parallel channels, which is a critical parameter for designing microfluidic devices.
the structure of a foam flowing through two parallel channels is determined by the ratio of their width, and this in turn determines the velocity of the foam.
